chatgptPrompt:
Create a YouTube Shorts / TikTok cover, 9:16 (1080x1920). Keep the focal point and the text inside the centre safe area: clear of the bottom 25% and of the right-hand button column.
Subject: a tiny figure standing on a calm night beach, seen from behind, looking up at a small full Moon over a quiet sea (a painted illustration).
Composition: the Moon in the upper centre, the figure small in the lower-centre foreground, a wide calm sea between, a dark headland on the left; text in the lower middle inside the safe area.
Lighting and treatment: teal (#4FE3C6) and violet (#5B3FD0) night, a silver road of moonlight on the water, indigo sky (#0B0F2A), painterly, soft grain.
Mood: quiet wonder.
Text: "3.8 cm a year" in a clean geometric sans (Lexend style), white with the number teal, centred in the lower middle.
Scientific accuracy: the real Moon is drifting away from Earth at about 3.8 centimeters a year; this video is a thought experiment about the opposite.
Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real news or NASA photo.
Style: premium editorial science documentary, painterly, distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art.
